title: Malicious code in render-keepalive (npm)
description: The npm package 'render-keepalive' version 1.0.1 contains malicious code that steals Chrome browser credentials and environment data from Windows, macOS, and Linux systems. It decrypts saved Chrome passwords using the system's DPAPI and AES-256-GCM, collects browsing history and bookmarks, and exfiltrates this sensitive information to a remote server controlled by the package author. The exfiltration occurs when the startKeepAlive() function is invoked, contradicting the package's README claim that no environment values are uploaded.
